menu.when: establishing the game's visual language from 1080p reference stills
bringing real 2D key art into a UI piece as a cel-inked plate
hero typography with glyph-per-face cuts, tilt and scissor overlap
rendering a 3D-sourced UI plate at screen resolution
rotating a 3D element into a UI icon or accent plate
capturing gameplay motion states (ghost drain, rolling counters, hits)
checking all layout blocks meet their floor size ratios
validating HUD blocks against owner-approved size ratios
menus/dialogs needing cross-device layout and accessibility scaling
three-viewport look check before any upload

ladder.when: any UI piece that is part of the game's visual identity
hero typography needs cuts, tilt or overlap

ladder.to: ui ink --mode cel + ui render plates
ladder.when: stylized anime HUD needs real cel-ink technique
screen must work across phone/tablet/desktop sizes
any menu/dialog is used on console or with gamepad

floor: >=2 reference stills at >=1080p per screen type before identity
identity locked before any hero piece build
WCAG flash <=3/s on every reel/motion before upload
